properties.title: Italy orthophoto mosaic, 2022-2024 flights
properties.description: The single mosaic covering all of Italy. One item, because the Zarr store is one continuous array rather than a set of scenes: there is no per-scene footprint to split it into. The bounding box is the valid data extent computed from the store's `valid_shape` and affine transform, so it is tile-aligned at zoom 18 and about 1 km larger than the imagery itself on the south and west edges. Within it, 25.4 percent of pixels carry imagery and the rest are alpha 0.

band.description: Rendered RGBA channels. Alpha is the coverage mask, not a colour.

y.description: Northing in EPSG:3857 metres, stored north to south.

x.description: Easting in EPSG:3857 metres, stored west to east.

rgba.description: Priority-merged RGBA orthophoto imagery, uint8, with 0 in the alpha band marking absence of AGEA coverage.

data.title: Italy aerial orthophoto mosaic, Zarr v3 multiscale store
data.description: The whole mosaic as one sharded Zarr v3 store with consolidated metadata. Groups 0 to 11 are the pyramid levels, 0 being full resolution. Open it through an S3-style store: Source Cooperative serves no directory listing over plain HTTP.

zarr-metadata.title: Consolidated Zarr root metadata
zarr-metadata.description: The store's own root metadata: multiscales layout, EPSG:3857 WKT2, tile matrix set, and the AGEA WMTS endpoints the imagery was fetched from.
